selection: Purposive development-only convenience sample of distinct claim families, frozen before responses; not random claim sampling or independent gold data
primary_endpoint: Within-slot enhanced-minus-baseline perceived usefulness; exploratory and conditional on these fixed items

confidence_intervals.method: percentile bootstrap of complete counterbalance-block mean within-slot differences

limitations: All selected complete current production rule-mode snapshots have Inconclusive verdicts; decisive verdicts and current NLI usefulness are not evaluated
Stored evidence mixes constructed passages and public excerpts; synthetic evidence is labeled and no public source is rechecked
Presentation length/content can reveal differences, so masking labels does not provide full participant blinding
Repeated questionnaire concepts can cause learning or ceiling effects; no feedback is given during the study
24 unfilled assignment slots are a planning assumption, not recruited people, observations or a power calculation
